Maths Path · Ages 3 to 4

Pre-primary 1 maths

Counting, shapes and sorting. Go in order. Pass each check to open the next chapter.

0 of 6 passed

PP1 chapters in order

  1. 1

    Count with me

    Touch each object once, then connect a small group to its number.

    • I can count a small group.
    • I can match a group to a number.
    • I can find the next number.
    Not started
  2. 2

    More, less and the same

    Compare groups and everyday sizes without racing.

    • I can find more or fewer objects.
    • I can compare big, tall and thick things.
    • I can compare weight and how full a jar is.
    Not started
  3. 3

    Meet the shapes

    Name familiar outlines and notice corners and matching shapes.

    • I can match a shape.
    • I can notice sides and corners.
    • I can find a shape in a picture.
    Not started
  4. 4

    Which ones belong?

    Sort familiar things by one visible rule before combining clues.

    • I can find things that belong together.
    • I can find the one that is different.
    • I can count just one group.
    Not started
  5. 5

    Where is it?

    Use position words with toys, pictures and simple rows.

    • I can find what is inside or outside.
    • I can find what is above or below.
    • I can find a place in a row.
    Not started
  6. 6

    What comes next?

    Say the repeating group aloud and continue a picture pattern.

    • I can continue a picture pattern.
    • I can find a missing picture.
    • I can notice how a pattern grows.
    Not started
